2610.07219.title: Cascadia: Resident 975B MoE Inference on Eleven AI PCs
2610.07219.paper_summary: Mixture-of-experts models make nearly trillion-parameter capacity accessible with sparse per-token computation, provided that the serving system can distribute the weights and coordinate their execution. We present Cascadia's resident execution of Inkling, a 975B-total/41B-active-parameter model, on eleven Intel Core Ultra X7 358H AI PCs, each with 64 GB of memory, Arc B390 integrated graphics and gigabit Ethernet. We contribute a custom resident MoE engine that preserves Inkling's routing rules, constructs compressed graphs for OpenVINO's fused iGPU primitives, and coordinates FP16 expert computation with FP32 output restoration. The engine fits six consecutive decoder layers per machine and represents dense feed-forward blocks as all-active expert slices, reducing measured dense-layer call time from approximately 8.1 to 4.5 ms. A streaming pipeline coordinates concurrent generation, while captured-state draft evaluation measures agreement with the deployed numerical path. Paired measurements at fifteen concurrency levels from 1 to 176 streams reach 60.29 aggregate decode tokens/s at 88 streams, with 46.87 tokens/s over the complete serving phases. At fifteen streams, median first-token latency is 6.05 s. Raising the context budget from the 1,024-position default, real prompts of 1k to 64k tokens recover the embedded code in all 19 measured answers, with first-token time growing as $aN+bN^2$ and decode latency growing approximately linearly, both bounded by a single-threaded CPU attention loop rather than by memory, which holds 512k positions per stream. Evaluation on captured fleet states separates the effects of vocabulary selection and weight quantization on draft agreement. Together, these contributions establish an execution and evaluation approach for large sparse models on distributed client systems with shared CPU-GPU memory.
2610.07219.paper_summary_zh: 混合專家模型使得接近兆參數的容量可以通過稀疏的每個標記計算來訪問，前提是服務系統能夠分配權重並協調它們的執行。<lb/>我們展示了Cascadia對Inkling的本地執行，這是一個總計975B/41B活躍參數的模型，運行在十一台Intel Core Ultra X7 358H AI PC上，每台擁有64 GB的內存、Arc B390集成顯卡和千兆以太網。<lb/>我們貢獻了一個自定義的本地MoE引擎，該引擎保留了Inkling的路由規則，為OpenVINO的融合iGPU原語構建壓縮圖，並協調FP16專家的計算與FP32輸出恢復。<lb/>該引擎每台機器適配六個連續的解碼器層，並將稠密前饋塊表示為全活躍的專家切片，將測量的稠密層調用時間從約8.1毫秒減少到4.5毫秒。<lb/>一個流式管道協調並行生成，同時捕獲狀態的草稿評估測量與部署的數值路徑的一致性。<lb/>在15個並發級別下進行的配對測量，從1到176個流在88個流時達到60.29的總解碼標記/s，完整服務階段的解碼速率為46.87標記/s。<lb/>在15個流時，首個標記的中位延遲為6.05秒。<lb/>將上下文預算從1,024位置的默認值提高，實際提示從1k到64k標記恢復了所有19個測量答案中的嵌入代碼，首個標記的時間隨著$aN+bN^2$增長，解碼延遲大約線性增長，兩者都受到單線程CPU注意循環的限制，而不是內存，內存每個流保持512k位置。<lb/>對捕獲的艦隊狀態的評估分離了詞彙選擇和權重量化對草稿一致性的影響。<lb/>總體而言，這些貢獻為大型稀疏模型在具有共享CPU-GPU內存的分佈式客戶端系統上的執行和評估方法奠定了基礎。
